acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000
collision energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
instrument: coupled directly to a Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled to a Q-TOF Premier MS (Waters/Micromass) using electrospray ionization in positive mode
labeling: Analysis was performed on an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano LC system (Dionex) fitted with a trapping cartridge (μ-Precolumn C18 PepMap 100) and an analytical column (nanoEase M/Z HSS T3 column, Waters) coupled directly to a Fusion Lumos (Thermo Fisher Scientific) mass spectrometer using the proxeon nanoflow source in positive ion mode.
reduction reagent: 0.5 mM TCEP, protease inhibitor, traces of DNaseI
reduction concentration: 0.5 mM TCEP, protease inhibitor, traces of DNaseI
